author: Meg Humble
title: Looking for character artists for 2 full body characters under £300
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰

author: romancefictionclub
title: Hiring character artist for large project
content: We’re looking to hire a character artist who can take on a large project. Any authors have reccomendations? Human made artwork only please.

author: auroracratebookbox
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please.

author: squirrel.35008284
title: Seeking artist for character art of two main novel characters, no AI
content: 🎨 Calling all artists! I’m planning to self-publish my novel within the next year and I’m looking for an artist to create character art for my two main characters. ✨ One important requirement: NO AI art or AI tools used at any stage of the process. I had a bad experience earlier this year with someone who claimed their work was fully human-made, only to discover otherwise after paying. I want to work with a real artist and support genuine creativity, and I’m happy to pay fairly for your work!

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character art artist for upcoming book, flexible payment
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! I am a romance author...
